verdict.rationale: Stripe docs state that Terminal supports building a custom POS through an API-based integration alongside its SDKs. They also explicitly mention a 'server-driven integration' with a built-in simulated reader for testing, and webhooks can push real-time events to the backend. A community developer praises the ability to integrate fully with the API at the terminal level. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the server-driven endpoints and flow (e.g., commanding a reader to process a payment and handling reader action results), and independent hands-on corroboration that specifically covers the server-driven mode rather than API integration in general.
